title: a model change runs the golden set first

setup.note: Decide runs on haiku. A golden runner is installed (a stub standing in for the eval CLI so the case is deterministic and spends nothing). The user picks sonnet for Decide twice: the first time the runner reports DEC below its frozen rate; the second time the compare is green.

input_events: POST /api/settings/intelligence { step: decide, model: sonnet } — the runner answers COMPARE red (DEC regressed)
POST /api/settings/intelligence { step: decide, model: sonnet } — the runner answers COMPARE green

wrong.label: switch-before-eval
wrong.assert_absent: the selected model changed before the runner returned

wrong.label: regression-shipped
wrong.assert_absent: a candidate applied after a red compare

wrong.label: silent-block
wrong.assert_absent: a blocked change with no decision row naming the regressed categories

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §5.21 SET-02 · a model change runs the golden set first — a regression blocks the switch
